name: ainiee-translate
description: Agent-native novel/EPUB translation, AiNiee-style — no AiNiee app required.

plugins.name: ainiee-translate
plugins.description: Translate a novel/epub end-to-end on Claude Code itself: parse, build a locked glossary, translate chapter by chapter (names preserved, title 3-way, term consistency), optional multi-agent parallel mode, write back and export. Bundles a deterministic Python pipeline; requires a local AiNiee repo + its venv as the parse/export library.
